prompt: Transcript busting the myth that AI is only for big companies. Single-person consulting client automated onboarding in 4 hours. User explicitly asks for LinkedIn to be 'professional and polished'.

assertions.text: Output contains all five platform sections: YouTube Description, LinkedIn Post, Instagram Caption, TikTok Caption, and Twitter/X
LinkedIn post reflects the user's explicit request to be 'professional and polished' — no casual slang or excessive emoji
The myth-busting angle ('AI isn't just for big companies') appears in at least one platform's hook
YouTube description includes keywords relevant to 'AI for small business' or 'AI productivity'
At least 3 niche hashtags from the approved list are present
Instagram caption is concise (under 5 sentences) with hashtags
TikTok caption is under 150 characters and casual in tone
No fear-mongering or hype language (no 'AI will change everything', 'AI is taking over')
